evidence_boundaries: The Rust integration tests execute all 27 independent analytic fixtures and compare their documented projections; CLI checks capture actual artifacts separately.
Built-in transaction profiles retain the existing prepare/run/validate/view interfaces. The public Registry/Context/Envelope extension API is not part of this implementation.
Transaction-level abstraction does not establish full AXI/AHB/RTL, JEDEC/physical DDR, cache coherence, CPU execution or hardware conformance.

Traceability success establishes document links, not unexecuted product or standards-conformance acceptance.
